subject.title: State publishers thrash under concurrent writes

question: Should ClawSweeper define a broader core concurrency guarantee for state publishers beyond the existing exact-publication fairness path, and if so which publisher operations must be coordinated?
rationale: The issue does not identify the competing writes or desired correctness property, while the only related concrete work explicitly concerns a distinct exact-publication starvation scenario.

options.title: Request a scoped concurrency report
options.body: Ask for the contending publisher paths, observed state/result, expected guarantee, and a current-main reproduction before choosing a core change.

options.title: Adopt a broader coordination contract
options.body: Define the publisher operations that require ordering or conflict resolution, then sponsor a bounded implementation and regression plan.

recommendation.title: Request a scoped concurrency report
recommendation.body: Ask for the contending publisher paths, observed state/result, expected guarantee, and a current-main reproduction before choosing a core change.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the only identified member connected to this otherwise unscoped report; implementation ownership needs source-history follow-up once the affected path is named.
